result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. I changed two files, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on the sorted contributor stream and the local `limit` variable. The "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note is gone. The bots and teams pages go through this same code, so they are covered too.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on `recentContributors` before the bar chart loop, so there is one bar per recently active contributor. The sort order is unchanged.

The configuration field and its getter/setter in `LandscapeConfiguration.java` are untouched, so the setting stays in place but no longer limits these lists.

I left `LandscapeRepositoriesReport.java` alone. It has its own "limited to" note for the repositories list, which is not part of this task.

`mvn -q -o -pl reports test -Dtest='Landscape*'` finished with no output, so I read that as a pass. I did not check the test count or the generated HTML, and I did not add a test for the new behaviour. Nothing is committed.
